input.body: We are writing about DoorDash order DD-51115 from 2026-11-04, for which $17.50 was deducted with the reason given as a missing item (Jhol Momo). The order ticket for DD-51115 lists 'Jhol Momo', which shows the item was part of the order as placed [DD-51115:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 12:55 and was picked up at 12:58, three minutes later [DD-51115:pickup_handoff]. We recognize that the ticket shows the item was ordered and does not by itself show what was in the bag at handoff. Based on the records above, we respectfully ask that you review this deduction. If the review supports it, we ask that the $17.50 be reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
